summary: Associate Technical Architect with nearly 20+ years of experience in application architecture, software design and development, project management, performance, security, and Agile delivery.

work_experience.summary: Progressed from Lead Engineer to Associate Technical Architect.
highlights: Supervised architectural and design specifications, translating business requirements into technical models and developer-level specifications.
Designed and built custom solution elements, including application architecture, database design, performance, security, and integration requirements.
Provided technical leadership for Agile Scrum teams, including task breakdown, estimation, code review, and delivery management.
Worked with ASP.NET, C#, VB.NET, SQL Server, WCF, Web Services, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, BackboneJS, Entity Framework, SSIS, and reporting technologies.
Implemented continuous integration, automated unit testing, TDD, load testing, profiling, production debugging, and application performance improvements.
Designed, developed, tested, troubleshot, and debugged enterprise applications.
Participated in requirements analysis, technical specifications, customer interaction, and delivery of software improvements.
Led project execution and guided application design, development, testing, and delivery activities.
Managed technical implementation and coordinated development work across project teams.
Developed and maintained software applications using Microsoft web and database technologies.
Contributed to coding, debugging, database development, and application delivery.

projects.title: Enterprise Application Architecture and Delivery
projects.summary: Designed and delivered enterprise web applications, eCommerce platforms, booking systems, payment integrations, reporting solutions, and administrative portals.
highlights: Architected distributed applications using ASP.NET, Web Services, WCF, SQL Server, and modern web technologies.
Integrated payment gateways, booking engines, reporting services, address lookup, and delinquency phone-call services.
Led technical design, performance and security improvements, coding, debugging, testing, and production support.

projects.title: Medical Report Summarizer and Diet Recommendation Platform
projects.summary: Led an internal hackathon project demonstrating practical AI engineering with OpenAI-powered medical report summarization and personalized diet recommendations.
highlights: Applied generative AI and OpenAI integration to transform unstructured medical report content into clear, actionable summaries.
Built support for uploading PDF reports, processing scanned documents, and accepting report content as text.
Sent extracted report content to OpenAI and displayed the generated summary in the application.
Developed a Python-based diet recommendation workflow based on the report content.
Migrated the solution to ASP.NET and C# for enterprise application integration.
